mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (indicating accommodative monetary policy) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (exceeding 0.2 percentage points over the past month) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), a high level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) when FEDFUNDS is above 2.0% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions, indicated by high levels of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS), signal robust economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS is above 150,000 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (indicating manufacturing contraction) signals a weakening supply chain and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls < 100 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both GDPC1 and HOUST are below their 12-month moving averages (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 1.5%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, which boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive in low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 1.5%) when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
